descriptions: Er is een nieuwe versie van deze dataset beschikbaar, zie het veld 'Relations'. De bestanden van de verouderde versie zijn niet meer te downloaden. Opinion of inhabitants of Ede about various aspects of living in Ede, the municipal policy and municipal facilities Crime, insecurity, and inconveniences in neighbourhood where respondent is living / quality of life / community centres / participation in arts and culture / information and involvement concerning town and country planning by the municipality / opinion about the 'Information Guide Municipality Ede 1997/1998' / environmental issues / suggestion for questions in next survey Background variables: basic characteristics/ residence/ housing situation/ household characteristics/ occupation/employment/ income/capital assets/ education/ politics/ religion
